decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a certification-heavy niche with long procurement and service cycles, so the firm will keep the line available.
The spring-balanced desk lamp still has its own page and fits the ergonomic office portfolio, though desk lamps are a more competitive, peripheral segment.
The second-generation general interior luminaire is core to the building lighting business and was only recently launched.
The microprismatic pendant is presented as a flagship of the firm's efficient, glare-free lighting direction, making withdrawal very unlikely.
Withdrawing the related marine searchlight F and the move away from HMI discharge lamps raise the risk, but marine customers need continued availability, so the firm likely keeps it for now.
